system.description:
Attack Action against one enemy: Opposed Strange Check vs its Smarts. On a win, roll a Skill Die to set its next Combat Turn: Grit/Wit it attacks another enemy, Smarts/Heart it moves away from you, Luck/Strange it attacks itself. Doom +2 when successful.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.63
system.summary: Attack Action against one enemy: Opposed Strange Check vs its Smarts. On a win, roll a Skill Die to set its next Combat Turn: Grit/Wit it attacks another enemy, Smarts/Heart it moves away from you, Luck/Strange it attacks itself. Doom +2 when successful.

automation.label: Opposed vs the target's Smarts
automation.onSuccess: Roll a Skill Die for the target's next Combat Turn: Grit/Wit attack another enemy; Smarts/Heart move away from you; Luck/Strange attack itself. Doom +2.

automation.note: Opposed check: target the enemy, then the Director rolls its Smarts and sets the CR so you need more successes. On a win, roll one Skill Die and the Director plays the target's next Combat Turn by the result.
